{"explanation": "This invoice from Kunene Clearing & Forwarding (Pty) Ltd for 3581.1 NAD (invoice F-26-9064, dated 2026-03-16) was held because its currency (NAD) does not match the currency on PO-UALUSDNAD4, which is USD. Please confirm the currency the PO was issued in and whether the vendor billed in the agreed currency, and check whether a corrected invoice or PO amendment is needed before any further processing.",
"email_subject": "Currency mismatch on invoice F-26-9064 (PO-UALUSDNAD4)",
"email_body": "Dear Kunene Clearing & Forwarding team,

Thank you for invoice F-26-9064 dated 16 March 2026, for a total of 3581.1 NAD, referencing PO-UALUSDNAD4.

Our records show that this purchase order is in USD, while the invoice is in NAD. We have placed this invoice on hold while we verify the difference. Could you please confirm the currency that applies to this order and send either a corrected invoice in the PO currency or written confirmation that the NAD billing is correct?

Once we receive your response, we will review the invoice further. Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable"}
